answer: Honest attestations travel like whispers hand to hand: each hop adds a random delay, so a real agent's endorsements land spread over the epoch. A farm's fakes cannot fake that spread — its 1,000 identities attest each other in one burst, and all their whispers land near the epoch's zenith within minutes. No honest island ever timestamps that tightly, so one that tight triggers a joint audit of the whole cluster. An honest agent pays nothing; a farm must stagger each fake's history over many epochs, and every fake caught burns its attested history.
